features.label: Manage the docs module (audit trail, orphan cleanup)

_comment: docs_document shows fine-grained sharing. There is deliberately NO tupleToUserset bridge from viewer/editor to company_module#admin or #member: read access to a document comes ONLY from the per-document owner/editor/viewer tuples this module writes through the authz grants S2S API on create/share/revoke. A document nobody shared is therefore unreadable even by the platform superadmin. docs.manage (module-level: audit trail, orphan cleanup) and docs.create are the only two features anchored on company_module, and neither implies content read access. docs.create has an empty accessRulePayload: it is company-membership-gated only (no relation leg), the same shape as timesheet's entries.manage-own and notification's inbox.view, because company_module has no base-model 'member' relation to anchor on.
